name: Confidence Ladder
loop: See a masked 30-day chart, set a probability that the next 5 days close higher, get Brier score and a calibration dot; ten rounds per run.
hook: Visible climb from sloppy to sharp bands unlocks harder charts.
risk: Players may read scores as trading skill; needs paper-only label.

name: Overconfidence Alarm
loop: Forecast eight masked charts; log score punishes 95% calls that miss; an alarm card names your habit after each run.
hook: Log penalty makes extremes feel dangerous and memorable.
risk: Alarm wording could read as advice; keep it about the player's forecasts.

name: Calibration Mirror
loop: Twelve quick probability calls, then a reliability curve of your 60%, 70%, 80% bins versus how often you were right.
hook: The curve is a personal mirror people want to improve and show.
risk: Small samples make curves noisy; must show sample size and bands.

name: Interval Archer
loop: Drag a range for where a masked asset lands in 10 days; a narrow range that holds scores big, a miss costs sharply.
hook: Tightening your aim while staying honest feels like archery.
risk: Interval scoring is unintuitive; needs a one-line explainer.

name: Ninety Percent Club
loop: Draw 90% intervals on ten charts; you win by hitting 9 of 10, not by being wide or tight, so coverage near 90% ranks top.
hook: Rewards truthful bands, an unusual target to chase.
risk: Leaderboard may push gaming sample size; require minimum rounds.

name: Brier Dojo
loop: Belts from white to black: each dojo level has generated paths with known odds, and you must match the true probability.
hook: Known ground truth lets players see exactly how far off they were.
risk: Synthetic odds must be labelled so players do not infer real markets.

name: Daily Forecast Card
loop: Each day one question on tomorrow's close direction; set a probability, lock it, and see the scored result next morning.
hook: One daily ritual builds a long calibration history.
risk: Daily streak pressure; do not reward streaks, only scores.

name: Five Questions Before Lunch
loop: Three day-ahead forecasts plus two long-shot checks; your running Brier over 30 days is your rating.
hook: Small daily dose with a slow honest rating.
risk: Day-ahead outcomes are near coin flips; scores mostly noise early.

name: Humility Meter
loop: A gauge drifts toward 'humble' when you stay near 50-70% on unclear charts and toward 'reckless' when you shout 99%.
hook: Playful gauge turns a statistics lesson into a character trait.
risk: Could imply 'humble' people trade better; avoid claims.

name: Bin Builder
loop: Fill ten probability bins one forecast at a time; the run ends when each bin has enough samples to read its hit rate.
hook: Collecting a full curve is a completion goal.
risk: Long grind to fill bins; cap run length.

name: Surprise Index
loop: After each call, a surprise number shows bits of information lost; the run total is your Surprise Index to lower.
hook: Bits are a fresh, concrete unit for being wrong.
risk: Jargon-heavy; needs plain labels.

name: Forecast Gym
loop: Pick a muscle: base rates, trends, volatility, reversals; five drills each teach one habit with a short lesson after each miss.
hook: Structured training with named skills.
risk: Lessons about patterns may sound like trading strategy; stay descriptive.

name: Base Rate Quiz
loop: Before any chart, guess how often an asset rises over 5 days historically; then forecast the chart, and compare to the base rate.
hook: Teaches anchoring on base rates, the most useful forecasting habit.
risk: Base-rate data must be accurate and sourced.

name: Two Charts One Edge
loop: See two masked charts; set your probability that A outperforms B; a friend gets the same pair via link and you compare Brier.
hook: Shareable head-to-head with a clear winner.
risk: Challenge links must not reveal answers; expire them.

name: Blind Drift
loop: Generated random walks with hidden drift; guess the probability that the next 20 steps end above start; truth is revealed.
hook: Teaches that noise looks like trend.
risk: Synthetic only; could discourage engagement if too humbling.

name: Coin Flip Honesty
loop: Fair-coin style paths where the right answer is exactly 50%; the score only rewards players who resist seeing patterns.
hook: Counterintuitive: the best play is to say 50% and mean it.
risk: Dull if overused; limit to a trainer module.

name: Ladder of Doubt
loop: Each rung allows a wider probability range: begin capped at 40-60%, earn 10-90%, then extremes only by proving calibration.
hook: Earned freedom to be bold gives a natural progression.
risk: Unlock gates may frustrate; show progress clearly.

name: Wager of Words
loop: Pick from words like 'unlikely, toss-up, likely, near-certain' that map to ranges; the game shows how you compare to common definitions.
hook: Fun for beginners who don't think in numbers.
risk: Verbal probabilities are vague; mapping must be shown.

name: Streak Breaker
loop: After three correct calls in a row, a hidden test checks if you grow overconfident; the run exposes your hot-hand error.
hook: Self-knowledge reveal after a winning streak.
risk: Must not reward streaks; only reveal the bias.

name: Confidence Roguelike
loop: Each floor is a masked chart; stake paper points equal to confidence; a miss at high confidence costs more, so survival needs calibration.
hook: Roguelike tension from risk and honest odds.
risk: Paper points must not be money-convertible; avoid gambling feel.

name: Interval Dungeon
loop: Each room asks for a range; wide ranges are safe but earn little; the dungeon boss requires tight coverage after 7 rooms.
hook: Risk-and-reward through range width.
risk: Dungeon theme with loss pressure; keep tone calm.

name: Overconfidence Boss
loop: The boss mirrors your worst bias from past runs and makes you forecast its charts; beat it by hedging where you failed before.
hook: Personalised boss makes each run learn from you.
risk: Personal data used as a game element; keep local to the user.

name: Hedge Cards
loop: Draft cards that modify your scoring (floor at 20%, cap at 80%, double-check) then forecast a chart set; builds around calibration.
hook: Deck-building around humility mechanics.
risk: Complexity; keep to six card types.

name: Sharpshooter Season
loop: A 60-day season; each day three forecasts; leagues rank by Brier skill, with reliability shown beside rank.
hook: Honest long-run ranking with seasonal reset.
risk: Leaderboards invite play compulsion; cap daily forecasts.

name: Calibrated Cup
loop: Friends league where the winner is the best calibrated, not the most right; ties broken by sample size.
hook: Friend banter around a statistic nobody has heard of.
risk: Group pressure; make leagues opt-in.

name: Skill Over Luck Rating
loop: Rating shows Brier skill with a confidence band; you only rank when the band separates from chance, per the app's lower-bound rule.
hook: Matches the app's TR-8 lower-bound ranking ethos.
risk: Slow to rank for new players; needs onboarding.

name: Ghost of Last Week
loop: Replay the same chart set as your past self; beat your own ghost's Brier to climb.
hook: Self-competition without other people.
risk: Replaying the same set breeds memorisation; rotate sets.

name: Verified Trade Guess
loop: Anonymised closed trades from the app's verified records; guess the probability that this trade ended in profit, from entry context.
hook: Ties the game to the app's real records, building trust in them.
risk: Privacy: even anonymised trades need strict de-identification.

name: Win Rate Reality Check
loop: Guess the win rate of a hidden anonymised trader after 20 trades, then see the true record and a confidence interval.
hook: Teaches how little 20 trades prove, matching app messaging.
risk: Anonymised profiles must not be identifiable.

name: Which Trader Is Lucky
loop: Two anonymised records with similar returns but different sample sizes; pick the one with stronger evidence of skill and give a confidence.
hook: Teaches reading statistics before following anyone.
risk: Could be read as advice about whom to follow; keep generic.

name: Drawdown Estimator
loop: Estimate the range of a trader's worst per-trade loss in a hidden record; the range is scored by coverage.
hook: Builds sense for tail risk.
risk: Anonymised data again; keep hidden until reveal.

name: Percent Only Pulse
loop: Percent-only charts with 0% on the axis; guess probability of a rise of more than 2% over 5 days; no prices, only percents.
hook: Matches the app's percent-only rule.
risk: Thresholds could imply trading triggers; keep neutral.

name: Tail Spotter
loop: Forecast the probability of an outsized move in either direction; log score rewards honest tail odds.
hook: Teaches fat tails honestly.
risk: Fear of tails could be read as a signal; avoid prescriptions.

name: Slow Burn Weekly
loop: Once a week, ten forecasts on end-of-week closes; the weekly report shows your calibration curve over eight weeks.
hook: Low pressure, long arc, easy to keep.
risk: Weekly cadence loses casual players.

name: Probability Poker Face
loop: You and a friend forecast the same chart; each sees the other's number only after locking in; closer-to-truth wins the round.
hook: Social reveal moment with no betting.
risk: Duel pressure; no stakes beyond points.

name: Sealed Forecast
loop: Lock a forecast on a delayed-live question, get a timestamped sealed card, and resolve it later; the card proves you did not edit after.
hook: Proof of honest pre-commitment mirrors the app's verified records.
risk: Timestamps need trusted time source.

name: Calibration Passport
loop: Earn stamps for reaching calibrated bins across asset types; a passport page shows where you are well-calibrated and where you are not.
hook: Collection and honesty together.
risk: Stamps could imply expertise per asset; add disclaimer.

name: Forecast Journal
loop: Write a one-line reason with each probability; later the journal shows which reasons correlated with good scores.
hook: Reflection loop that rewards thinking.
risk: Free text must be moderated like theses.

name: Reason Tags
loop: Tag each forecast with why (trend, reversal, gut, base rate); at the end see which tag produced your best calibration.
hook: Fast to use and surprising to learn from.
risk: Tag results on small samples can mislead; show counts.

name: Gut Versus Number
loop: Give a gut call first, then a numerical probability after a base-rate hint; the game scores which version was better over time.
hook: Teaches when intuition helps.
risk: Prompt framing might be read as instruction.

name: Prior and Posterior
loop: Forecast, see new data points appear, update your forecast; score is how much you moved compared to what the data warranted.
hook: Bayesian updating in a 2-minute loop.
risk: Math-heavy; keep visuals simple.

name: Update Speed
loop: Evidence arrives in steps; you are scored for moving your probability the right amount, not too little and not too much.
hook: Under- and over-reaction both get named.
risk: Hard concept; teach with a tutorial.

name: Cone Painter
loop: Paint a forecast cone over a masked chart's future: 50% and 90% bands at three horizons; each band is scored separately.
hook: Visual, tactile, closer to how a forecast is shown.
risk: Drag input is hard on phones; need larger handles.

name: Fan Chart Duel
loop: Two players paint cones on the same chart; the reveal shows the true path versus both cones, and tighter honest cone wins.
hook: Visual reveal is share-worthy.
risk: None beyond duel pressure.

name: Median Chaser
loop: Guess the median return in a 10-day window, plus your confidence that the real value lands within 3% of it.
hook: Two-part forecast trains point and spread together.
risk: Two numbers is more cognitive load.

name: Decile Dash
loop: Spread 100 chips across outcome buckets (down big, down, flat, up, up big); log score rewards putting chips where outcomes land.
hook: Chip-spread forecasting feels like a board game.
risk: Chips mimic betting; label them as probability mass.

name: Whole Distribution
loop: Shape a full probability histogram for a masked chart's next 5-day return; score is log of the bucket where it landed.
hook: Trains full distributions, not just direction.
risk: Complex; unlock after simpler drills.

name: Rank the Five
loop: Order five masked charts by which will rise most over 5 days and attach a confidence; score uses rank correlation and calibration.
hook: Relative forecasting is a different skill from absolute.
risk: Rankings could read as stock-picking; masked data helps.

name: Pair Spread
loop: Swipe left or right for which of two masked paths rises more, then tap a confidence; a score multiplier ties to honest confidence.
hook: Fits the app's swipe feed language.
risk: Multiplier could pressure players; tie to calibration only.

name: Swipe With Odds
loop: Swipe up or down on a masked chart with a confidence ring you hold longer for higher confidence; release locks the call.
hook: Gesture-based confidence is fast and tactile.
risk: Hold gestures hard to learn.

name: Hold the Doubt
loop: Press and hold to raise confidence while a ticker clock runs; letting go locks it; more time held raises both reward and penalty.
hook: Physical, tense, quick.
risk: Tension may feel like gambling.

name: Confidence Budget
loop: You get a fixed budget of 'sureness' points to distribute across ten charts; use them where you know, spend little where you don't.
hook: Forces trade-offs in conviction, like attention.
risk: Budget mechanic could be confusing.

name: Three Lives Sure
loop: Start with three lives; a 90% miss costs one life, a 60% miss none; survive twelve charts to finish the run.
hook: Lives make overconfidence feel costly.
risk: Loss framing; no real money.

name: Probability Tarot
loop: Draw modifier cards each floor (blur, double-bet, hint); calibrated play with weird modifiers builds a score; the run ends when your Brier drifts.
hook: Each run feels different via modifiers.
risk: Card theme must not resemble divination for trades.

name: Run-End Report Card
loop: A 3-minute run of 12 charts ends with a report card: calibration, overconfidence count, best bin, and one habit to practice.
hook: Satisfying summary at the end of each run.
risk: Habit hint must stay descriptive.

name: Ascension Humility
loop: Beat the base run to unlock modifiers like no extremes, time pressure, noisy charts; higher ascension keeps scoring honest.
hook: Roguelike ascension pairs with calibration goal.
risk: Time pressure may degrade learning.

name: Noise Floor
loop: Charts vary in noise; a good forecaster says 50% on pure noise and sometimes 65% when a drift is built in; scoring checks both.
hook: Teaches telling signal from noise.
risk: Synthetic: avoid implying real markets have simple drifts.

name: Seed Hunter
loop: Share a seed number and a friend forecasts the exact same generated charts; compare calibration curves.
hook: Seeds are easy to share and fair.
risk: Seeds may be farmed; keep synthetic only.

name: Time Capsule Forecast
loop: Seal a probability on a question that resolves in 30 days; a capsule opens later with the score and how your confidence evolved.
hook: Anticipation and honest feedback.
risk: Long resolution loses people; offer reminders only.

name: Calibration Streak Honest
loop: A calibration streak only counts days where you were not consistently extreme; extremely bold days never extend it.
hook: A streak that rewards care rather than volume.
risk: Any streak is a compulsion lever; keep gentle.

name: Tell Me Why Not
loop: After you lock a call, the game asks for the strongest reason you could be wrong, and a second lower number you could move to.
hook: Steel-manning the opposite improves calibration.
risk: Extra step slows play.

name: Pre-Mortem Round
loop: Before the reveal, pick which of three failure stories is most likely if you are wrong; later see if your story matched the real miss.
hook: Pre-mortem thinking as a mini game.
risk: Stories could resemble commentary; keep generic.

name: Forecast Relay
loop: Watch a friend's sealed forecasts resolve live in a feed and add your own side probability; no wagering.
hook: Social viewing of outcomes.
risk: Spectating may encourage following others' calls.

name: Crowd Wisdom Mirror
loop: See how your forecast compares with the average of the crowd and a calibrated base rate; learn whether you add or subtract value.
hook: Crowd comparison is instantly interesting.
risk: Crowd average shown may anchor players; reveal after lock.

name: Wisdom Delta
loop: Your score is how much better or worse you do than the crowd's average on the same charts; Delta rating reflects the gap.
hook: Rewards independent accuracy.
risk: Needs enough crowd data.

name: Coach Bot Debrief
loop: After a run, a plain-language debrief explains your reliability curve in three sentences and one drill to try next.
hook: Personal coaching without a coach.
risk: Generated text must avoid advice; templated only.

name: Bias Bingo
loop: Squares like 'overconfident on rises' or 'underconfident on drops' fill as the game spots them; a full row is a badge.
hook: Light, funny way to learn biases.
risk: Badges for biases could shame; use gentle wording.

name: Ten Day Trainer
loop: A ten-day story course: each day a short scenario, three forecasts, and a lesson on one calibration idea.
hook: Course structure feels like learning, not gambling.
risk: Daily energy limit may feel gamey; keep soft.

name: Reliability Garden
loop: Each probability bin is a plant that grows when your hit rate matches the label; overconfidence wilts it.
hook: Calm, cosmetic, honest.
risk: Cute design could trivialise; keep informative.

name: Honest Odds Tower
loop: Stack blocks as you correctly state probabilities; extremes make the tower tall but wobbly, moderate keeps it stable.
hook: Physical metaphor for risk.
risk: Gamified risk pushes more extremes if poorly tuned.

name: Fog of War Charts
loop: A chart is revealed in fog; each extra week you uncover lowers the max score; decide how much data you need before committing.
hook: Teaches value of information.
risk: Reward for less data may mislead.

name: Peek Price
loop: You can buy extra hints with score points; the best players learn which hints actually improve calibration.
hook: Meta-decision about information.
risk: Hint economy resembles in-game purchases; points only.

name: Stop Sign Drill
loop: Tap up or down quickly; a stop button asks 'sure?' and a no logs low confidence; calibration is computed from your stops.
hook: Frictionless input with implied confidence.
risk: Implicit confidence is noisy.

name: Forecast Radio
loop: A daily feed of other forecasters' sealed probabilities appears after lock; you see the spread but not their names.
hook: Anonymous crowd feel.
risk: Anonymity must hold up; no deanonymisation.

name: Question Writer
loop: Players write a resolvable question (from a menu of templates) for friends to forecast; the author is scored on question clarity.
hook: Creation is engaging and fair.
risk: User-written text needs moderation.

name: Mentor Pairs
loop: A well-calibrated player pairs with a learner on the same set; the mentor earns points when the learner's calibration improves.
hook: Collaborative rather than zero-sum.
risk: Mentor claims may read as endorsement; label peer.

name: Team Calibration
loop: A team's score is the Brier of its pooled forecasts; each member's marginal contribution is shown to improve the team.
hook: Cooperative score with an honest breakdown.
risk: Blame dynamics; show positives.

name: Bold Corner
loop: A 'bold corner' allows two extreme calls per run with a fixed small penalty; bold success shows a gentle highlight.
hook: Lets people feel bold without wrecking the score.
risk: Rewarding boldness may encourage risk-taking.

name: Anti-Gambler Mode
loop: A mode that adds a calm check after three quick runs and displays time played; no scoring bonus for volume.
hook: Product honesty as a feature.
risk: Must be on by default.

name: Gap Between Confidence and Hit
loop: A single number, your calibration gap, shown as an arrow between 'how sure' and 'how right', is the headline of every run.
hook: One number is easy to share and improve.
risk: Single metric oversimplifies.

name: Prediction Trails
loop: A calendar of daily forecast dots coloured by how well-calibrated that day's call was relative to outcome, not hit or miss.
hook: Colours track process, not luck.
risk: Calendar encourages streaks.

name: Sleep On It
loop: Forecast at noon, then you may revise by evening with a small penalty; the game compares first and revised calls.
hook: Teaches when second thoughts help.
risk: Revision window can feel like day trading; keep tiny.

name: Weather Report Mode
loop: The game voices forecasts like a weather report ('70% chance of an up week'); bins have little icons; you read your own forecast aloud.
hook: Familiar framing for probability.
risk: Cutesy framing could trivialise losses; neutral tone.

name: Expected Score Guess
loop: Besides the forecast, guess your own expected score; the gap between expected and real score is metacognition training.
hook: Forecasting your own forecasting skill.
risk: Hard to grasp at first.

name: Skill Leaderboard Lower Bound
loop: Ranks use the lower end of your skill interval, so few forecasts cannot top the board; more honest play raises the floor.
hook: Fair leaderboard consistent with TR-8.
risk: Slow to show on board for new people.

name: Paper Book Calibration
loop: Size paper positions only from your stated probabilities (Kelly-like sizing scale) and see paper return versus calibration.
hook: Shows how miscalibration hurts returns.
risk: Sizing rules may look like advice; keep as game math.

name: Overbet Detector
loop: A paper book where position size follows confidence; a replay line shows what the same run would earn at honest sizing.
hook: Counterfactual shows the cost of overconfidence.
risk: Counterfactual sizing is not guidance; label as simulation.

name: Cash Is A Forecast
loop: Holding paper cash counts as a 'no forecast' option; the run scores risk-adjusted return and how often you chose to abstain wisely.
hook: Abstaining is a legit move.
risk: May discourage investing; stay neutral.

name: Abstain Badge
loop: You can pass on up to a third of charts; a pass is scored as a 50% call but shows your selective accuracy on the rest.
hook: Rewards knowing what you don't know.
risk: Selection bias; show total too.

name: Spectator Gallery
loop: Watch replays of strong calibration runs, with anonymous handles and the reliability curve building as they forecast.
hook: Learn by watching.
risk: Spectated play may imitate rather than think.

name: Elder Council
loop: A story run: advisors with fixed bias profiles offer opinions; learn to weigh them by their calibration, not their confidence.
hook: Teaches discounting loud sources.
risk: Advisors imitating gurus; make fictional and generic.

name: Source Weighing
loop: Several fictional sources give forecasts with known histories; allocate trust weights, then see whose record deserved it.
hook: Teaches track-record thinking, mirroring verified records.
risk: Must be clearly fictional.

name: Verified Versus Vibes
loop: Compare anonymised verified records with confident claims without records; rate which deserves more trust and how sure you are.
hook: Reinforces why verification matters.
risk: Could appear to denigrate others; keep generic.

name: Hit Rate Illusion
loop: Shown a 70% win rate over 10 trades, estimate the probability the true rate is above 55%; the answer teaches intervals.
hook: Quick statistics lesson with real shapes.
risk: Keep numbers hypothetical.

name: Rolling Calibration Score
loop: A single rolling 90-day calibration score on your profile next to the app's records; no prizes.
hook: Dovetails with the app's trust story.
risk: Public scores must not imply trading skill.

name: Forecast Receipts
loop: Each resolved forecast issues an immutable receipt showing the probability and time, so you cannot rewrite history.
hook: Receipts mirror the app's frozen-record principle.
risk: Receipts could be used as brag; fine.

name: Tail Insurance Game
loop: Pay a small paper premium to cap loss in synthetic crashes; see when hedging helped and when it was drag over many runs.
hook: Shows cost of protection honestly.
risk: Synthetic; avoid derivative detail.

name: Honest Best Guess Race
loop: Race a ghost whose forecasts are perfectly calibrated at a hidden skill level; guess whether it is better than you.
hook: A benchmark opponent teaches humility.
risk: Ghost's skill must be disclosed truthfully.

name: Quiet Hours Quiz
loop: Five quick forecasts, then a one-screen result and a stop prompt; the game ends itself so you leave sharper, not hooked.
hook: Short and finite, a calm contrast to feeds.
risk: Low engagement by design; commercial tension.

name: Sibling Charts
loop: Forecast two charts whose shapes look alike but ended differently, to feel how similar setups give varied outcomes.
hook: Humbling and fun to see lookalikes diverge.
risk: Pattern talk may seem like chart-reading advice.
